g.text: Domain × latency class · every ledger case is shown in every assigned class
Cells show RB suffix: calendar-year lag. ? = unknown, never zero; * = partly secondary evidence. A case can occupy several cells.
Intervals have different endpoints and are not comparable discovery speeds. Use the interactive companion for anchors,
